lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's fifty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 50? Nope!

lines.text: Pick from one to one hundred, but none may be double or triple another.
lines.caption: Pick from 1 to 100, but none may be double or triple another.

lines.text: What's the most you can pick?
lines.caption: What's the most you can pick?

lines.text: Divide out all twos and threes. Numbers left with one fill this grid.
lines.caption: Divide out all 2s and 3s. Numbers left with 1 fill this grid.

lines.text: Right is double, up is triple. So clashes are neighbors!
lines.caption: Right is double, up is triple. So clashes are neighbors!

lines.text: Pair neighbors into dominoes. Each keeps at most one number.
lines.caption: Pair neighbors into dominoes. Each keeps at most one number.

lines.text: Smaller grids hold the rest. In total, thirty-nine dominoes!
lines.caption: Smaller grids hold the rest. In total, 39 dominoes!

lines.text: So keep at most one hundred minus thirty-nine. That's sixty-one!
lines.caption: So keep at most 100 minus 39. That's... 61!

lines.text: Fifty was the trap. It's not the most!
lines.caption: 50 was the trap. It's not the most!

lines.text: Did you get sixty-one? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 61? Tell me below!
